text:
Nina: heads-up — after the midnight deploy we started seeing a bump in invoice-preview diffs, looks correlated with DLQ retries from the meter-ingest consumer. tagging @Elena (oncall) and @Marc for visibility
Jordan: saw that, good catch. what did the DLQ look like? any common schema error or is it retries due to transient downstream?
Nina: sample DLQ payload pasted below, mostly healthy schema. seems like transient rejects from route-enrichment with 5xx -> we retry and end up double-counting preview vs final because preview consumer processed before final de-dup finished
Nina: ```json
{"event_id":"evt_8f3a","tenant":"acct-234","route":"embed-heavy","tokens":142,"error":"502 upstream timeout","retry_count":3}
```
Priya: hmm that suggests our preview pipeline is consuming earlier than finalizer/ledger reconciliation. we should probably add a retry-window metric and expose DLQ retry_count on the console route page
Sam: agreed, plus we currently re-ingest DLQ items with exponential backoff but no idempotency key at the preview stage. added a TODO to add request_fingerprint to the DLQ message before requeueing
Elena (oncall): can we toggle DLQ-replay to disabled for the canary tenants until we patch? would reduce noise in invoices.
Marc: +1. we need a short-term guard: if retry_count > 2, drop re-ingest to preview stream and route to manual review queue. otherwise preview will show inflated credits
Jordan: implementation plan: 1) add fingerprint and consumer-side dedupe (low effort) 2) add DLQ_retry_count metric in telemetry and surface in console per-route 3) add a per-tenant toggle to skip replay for preview consumers
Priya: UX ask: console should show a lightweight badge on the route preview panel: "DLQ replaying: X recent" and link to a small runbook. ops need that to triage invoice diff tickets quickly
Sam: patch ready for (1) and (2) — PR inbound. for 3 we need a feature flag + small api on routing-service to mark tenants as "preview-skip-dlq"
Nina: can we also add a rate limiter for DLQ replays? one shard's DLQ replay tripped our enrichment and caused cascading 429s which fed more retries.
Marc: yes — set soft QPS cap per-tenant for DLQ replay, circuit opens if enrichment errors > 10% over 5m. fallback = write to manual-review queue + alert to billing-bot
billing-bot: alert created: invoice-preview-dlq-replay-circuit tripped for tenant acct-234 at 2026-03-22T02:10:11Z
Elena (oncall): for immediate mitigation I toggled preview-skip-dlq for the canary group. keeping replay enabled for finalizer ledger only. monitoring invoice-preview diffs now.
Jordan: thanks. next steps & owners: Sam -> PRs for fingerprint + metric (ETA 4h), Marc -> add replay rate limiter + circuit (ETA EOD), Priya -> console badge mock + runbook link (ETA EOD), Nina -> runbook + monitor dashboard alerts (ETA next 2h)
Priya: I'll mock the console badge and a small drill-down with counts (dlq_count, retry_rate, replay_qps). want it on the route detail page and invoice preview overlay
Sam: quick note about telemetry names: please use meter.dlq.replay.count and meter.dlq.retry_rate for consistency with existing metrics.
Nina: logging the action items here. will open a follow-up thread for the rollout checklist (canary -> global). thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Marc: also drop a short note in the billing slack channel so CS doesn't get surprised if previews shift while we flip flags
Jordan: done. pinged #support and #billing.
Priya: one last UX question — when previews are suppressed for a tenant, should the console show the last good preview or an explicit "suppressed due to DLQ replay" state? ops preference?
Elena (oncall): prefer explicit suppressed state + link to runbook. reduces 'is it broken' tickets.
Nina: agreed. ok moving forward on that.
